name: Do I need a plumber to install a new toilet?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a plumber to install a new toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some homeowners attempt DIY toilet installation, hiring a professional plumber ensures the job is done correctly and prevents potential leaks or damage. A professional plumber has the tools and expertise to properly remove the old unit, inspect and repair the flange, ensure a watertight seal, and connect the water supply. This helps avoid common issues like a rocking toilet, slow leaks, or improper flushing, which can lead to costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a plumber for toilet installation ensures proper setup, prevents leaks, and avoids potential damage from improper installation.
